channel.title: Networking on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Networking on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Firewall for Containers
item.description:
Azure Firewall for Containers is in public preview. It extends Azure Firewall protections to containerized workloads so network traffic for container environments can be secured and managed centrally.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: ai: Hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service at Ignite 2026: from pilot to production inside your enterprise boundaries
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry Agent Service added enterprise-focused hosted agent capabilities at Ignite 2026, including shared subnet IPs, private CA trust, network egress controls, deployment to customer-managed AKS clusters, resilient execution, and memory snapshots.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: azure: [In preview] Generally Available: Private endpoint support for Azure HorizonDB clusters
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB clusters now support private connectivity through Azure Private Link with a private IP from your virtual network. Private DNS integration simplifies setup, and public access can be disabled for tighter network control.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Perimeter link (cross perimeter) in network security perimeter
item.description:
Public preview adds perimeter links for secure cross-perimeter connectivity between resources protected by different network security perimeters, while preserving perimeter-based access controls.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Scale ExpressRoute Direct connectivity with link groups
item.description:
Azure ExpressRoute Direct now supports link groups in public preview. This lets high-throughput workloads scale connectivity by aggregating links, reducing the need to manage multiple independent ExpressRoute connections.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure DDoS Protection support for NAT Gateway v2 IP
item.description:
Azure DDoS Protection now supports the public IPs used by Azure NAT Gateway StandardV2 in public preview. This extends network-layer DDoS protection to IPv4 and IPv6 addresses carrying outbound internet traffic.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Functions Network Troubleshooter v2
item.description:
Azure Functions Network Troubleshooter v2 is now in public preview. It provides a top-down view of Function App dependencies across Storage, Service Bus, and Azure Files, with inspection details for supported dependencies.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – Connection analyzer
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher’s Connection analyzer for ExpressRoute Circuit is in public preview. It helps pinpoint where packet loss occurs between Azure and on-premises by providing faster, evidence-based troubleshooting.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Network Watcher VNet Flow Logs enriched with networkInterfaceIP field
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher VNet Flow Logs now include a new networkInterfaceIP field in public preview. The field records the IP address or addresses of the network interface where a flow was captured.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Multicloud Interconnect new cloud service provider support
item.description:
Azure Multicloud Interconnect is now generally available as a managed service for private connectivity between Azure and supported cloud providers. Google Cloud Platform support is in public preview, and Amazon Web Services support is included in the announcement text but truncated.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Generally Available: Route maps for Azure Route Server
item.description:
Route maps for Azure Route Server are now generally available in the Azure public cloud. They add fine-grained control over inbound and outbound routing across hybrid connections.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Change from virtual network integration to a private endpoint capable network configuration in Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now supports changing existing VNet-integrated servers from delegated-subnet networking to a private endpoint-capable network configuration. This gives more flexibility in network design for existing workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Webhook IP ranges added to the Meta API
item.description:
GitHub added IP ranges for webhook deliveries on github.com to the Meta API. The new ranges appear in the hooks field, so allowlists for webhook traffic should be updated from the API data.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.102
item.description:
Release 1.0.102 updates Copilot CLI behavior around model selection, permissions, plugin sources, shell completion, chat flow, retry handling, and sandbox networking. It also fixes a few reliability issues in subagent workflows, long-running sandboxed commands, and provider overload retries.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Disable VNet peering route
item.description:
Azure announced public preview of Disable VNet Peering Route (DPR), a route-table capability that suppresses system-generated peering routes on subnets associated with the route table. This gives more control over traffic flow between peered virtual networks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Databricks Private network gateway
item.description:
Azure Databricks Private network gateway is now in Public Preview. It lets serverless compute reach resources in your VNet and transitively connected networks through a single managed gateway.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Standard service endpoint
item.description:
Azure introduced Standard service endpoint as a generally available capability in the Azure Private Link family. It is designed to provide a scalable, secure way to connect Azure IaaS workloads to Azure PaaS services, addressing manageability and scale limitations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Managed StandardV2 NAT Gateway for AKS
item.description:
AKS now provisions and manages a StandardV2 NAT Gateway for clusters using an AKS-managed virtual network. For new clusters in supported regions with managedNATGateway outbound type, StandardV2 is the default managed NAT Gateway SKU.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: New Windows App client-side endpoints for Azure Virtual Desktop
item.description:
Windows App will start using three new wildcard FQDNs for client-side service traffic to Azure Virtual Desktop beginning in early October 2026. The domains are already part of the cloud-side connectivity requirements.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Firewall auto-learn SNAT routes
item.description:
Azure Firewall auto-learn SNAT routes is now generally available. It periodically learns registered and private destination prefixes and applies them as No-SNAT ranges to preserve original source IPs and reduce manual SNAT management.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Multicloud Interconnect
item.description:
Azure Multicloud Interconnect is now in public preview. It provides managed private connectivity between Azure and supported cloud providers, with AWS as the first provider available in preview.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: IPv6 dual-stack support for Azure Bastion
item.description:
Azure Bastion now supports IPv4 and IPv6 dual-stack configurations in public preview. New Bastion deployments can be configured with both IPv4 and IPv6 public IP addresses.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Connect to AKS clusters using Azure Bastion
item.description:
Azure Bastion integration with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is now generally available. It lets customers create a secure tunnel from a local machine through Azure Bastion to an AKS cluster API server.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SRE Agent VNet Integration
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent VNet Integration is now generally available. It lets the agent operate within existing network controls such as NSGs, private DNS, and firewall policies.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: eBPF host routing in Advanced Container Networking Services for AKS
item.description:
eBPF Host Routing for Advanced Container Networking Services in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is now generally available. It moves packet forwarding and routing decisions into the Linux kernel to improve Kubernetes networking performance.

  • Source: Azure Updates
